Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Dhirendra Prasad Sinha, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.H.A. Khan, Adv.
 Mr. Javed Aslam, Adv.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 3 20-06-2023 Heard the parties.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 147, 148, 149, 323, 341, 384, 498A, 406/34 of the Indian Penal Code and  of the D.P. Act.
The matter was sent to the Mediation Centre, Patna High Court and consequently, the dispute between the parties has been resolved through the process of mediation.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, be released on provisional bail for a period of six months, in the event of his arrest or surrender Patna High Court CR.

within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand)
with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No. 501 of 2022, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
